candidates.name: code-branch
candidates.prompt: Design a distinctive professional open source .NET rule compiler project icon for CRules. Only an icon, no letters, no words, no numbers. Concept A: two bold opposing code braces form an almost circular C-shaped container; within the negative space a tiny elegant fork with two square endpoints represents if/else decisions compiled into one result. The main silhouette must remain exceptionally simple, one integrated geometric emblem, thick precise strokes and generous negative space. Electric indigo and vivid cyan on transparent background. Flat vector-like graphic, no 3D, no drop shadows, no textures, no mockup, no surrounding frame. Center the emblem with generous transparent margin; readable as a 32px GitHub avatar and NuGet package icon. Square composition. Original premium developer-tool identity, avoid generic chip/circuit clutter.

candidates.name: cr-monogram

Make it balanced and recognizable as CR, not a random abstract symbol. Restrained dark navy with a small bright blue accent. Flat vector-like brand mark, no 3D, no shadow, no texture, no mockup, no enclosing app tile. Transparent background. Thick clean silhouette and negative space, square composition with generous margins. Works at 32px, a premium enduring software library identity.
